title: All Optimized
description: This Modpack has all opimizations u can think of!
body:
ALL OPTIMIZED

Welcome to All Optimized, the ultimate optimization modpack designed to boost your performance and elevate your gameplay experience without compromising the core feel of the game.

✨Key Features

Massive FPS Boosts: Packed with the latest and most efficient optimization mods (like Sodium/Lithium) to ensure smooth gameplay even on low-end hardware.

Reduced Stuttering & Lag: Features memory usage optimizations and improved chunk loading mechanics for a seamless experience.

Quality of Life Improvements: Includes subtle tweaks to the UI, faster world loading times, and better video settings menus.

Server-Friendly: Optimized to consume less bandwidth and provide a stable connection to multiplayer servers.

🛠️Why Choose This Pack?

Unlike heavy modpacks that bloat your game, All Optimized focuses purely on performance, stability, and compatibility. Whether you are playing on a potato PC or looking to maximize your high-refresh-rate monitor, this pack is tailored for you.
